description:
Make your campfire the heart of your base, repelling mobs and healing your character.

# Healing Campfires

Make your campfire the heart of your base. A lit campfire (regular or soul) now:

- **Heals nearby players** — 1 HP every 4 seconds within 4 nodes, by default.
- **Stops hostile mobs spawning nearby** — within 16 nodes, even through walls.
  Spawn eggs and mob spawners still work.
- **Scares hostile mobs away** — within 6 nodes, much like creepers fleeing cats.
  A creeper that has already lit its fuse won't stop, just like in Minecraft.

Put the fire out and everything returns to normal.

## Settings
All settings are in the main menu under Settings → Mods → Healing Campfire:
healing range, interval and amount, an optional heal message in chat, the
no-spawn radius, the fear radius, and a list of mobs that ignore campfire fear
(bosses, the elder guardian and shulkers by default). Set a radius to 0 to turn
that feature off.

## Compatibility
Made for Mineclonia (Luanti 5.10 or newer). Spawn-proofing and fear need
Mineclonia's mob API; if it isn't present, healing still works and the log
explains what was skipped.

## How this was made
Designed, tested and maintained by Legacy_Tall_Grass. The code was written
with AI assistance (Claude), then checked against Mineclonia's own source and
tested in real worlds. Bug reports are welcome.

## Credits
Built to complement Mineclonia, with thanks to the Mineclonia and Luanti
developers whose work makes mods like this possible.
